core_obligations: Set I = (f_1, ..., f_m); the naive cotangent complex of A over R is homotopy equivalent to I/I^2 -> direct sum A dx_i.
Smoothness of R -> A at q gives a split injection (I/I^2)_a -> direct sum A_a dx_i for some a not in q.
Renumber so that f_1, ..., f_c map to a basis of (I/I^2)_a and dx_{c+1}, ..., dx_n to a basis of the localized module of differentials, after enlarging a by a factor avoiding q.
Conclude that a^N for large N satisfies the two displayed strict-standard conditions with U = V = {1, ..., c}.
proof_roadmap: Cotangent-complex presentation; localized split injection; basis renumbering; power of the denominator.
difficulty_reason: A three-step construction whose content is producing the split injection at a prime and converting it into the strict-standard equations for a power of a.
